title: Does the handoff export exist in v1, and what produces it?
statement: REQ-0010 requires a handoff actionable without returning to the planner, and #19 specifies docs/plan/ with data, docs, site and PLAN.md. Nothing produces any of it. Is the export in v1, and is it a command, a gate action, or a stage-9 agent task?
notes: #21 makes publishing an explicit command rather than automatic, which constrains the answer but does not give it. #87 says the aggregate belongs at handoff as a projection — so the export is where that projection is finally built, and it has no owner.
